used_documents.title: Mr. Noodle
used_documents.text: According to writer and `` Elmo 's World '' co creator Judy Freudberg , `` Mr. Noodle , who never speaks , is all about trial and error . When you throw him a hat , he acts like he 's never seen one before . Kids feel empowered watching him because they can do what he ca n't '' . According to Sesame Street researcher Lewis Bernstein , the characters , whom he called `` bungling '' , gave young viewers `` the opportunity to figure it out '' before the adults did .
